source.retrieval: metadata.json, unicode.json, package.json and LICENSE per family from raw.githubusercontent.com at the pinned commit; no font binaries were downloaded
source.licence: Fontsource packaging code is MIT; each family carries its own font licence below

classification: Spine fit, counter-fit, the small-size legibility trait and brand tones are Mishh Mashh curated judgments, not source claims. No family is exclusive to one spine.

localBytes.method: Local files are upstream Google Fonts-served subsets already bundled with the official example plugins; cmap coverage, weight and axes were measured once at snapshot time. The daemon only checks size, magic and sha256 at runtime.
